title: 5 reasons your listing gets no DMs
hook: 5 REASONS YOUR LISTING GETS NO DMS
angle: The listing isn't bad, it's invisible: photo dump, no hook, hidden basics, a weak next step and posting once. Fix the packaging before you look for more listings.

five_elements.target: Agency owners in Accra whose listing posts get ignored
five_elements.outcome: More DMs on the listings you already have
five_elements.pain: Posts that get a few likes and no messages

playbook_section: Why most listings get no messages (all five)

title: What an AI listing video actually is
hook: WHAT IS AN AI LISTING VIDEO, REALLY?
angle: Many agents hear 'AI video' and picture fake houses. I explain it simply: AI takes your real listing photos and adds smooth, slow camera moves so they play like a short tour.

five_elements.target: Agents who are curious but unsure about AI
five_elements.outcome: A listing video that looks premium
five_elements.benefit: Using the photos you already have, no filming
five_elements.pain: Not knowing what AI does, so ignoring it
five_elements.solution: The 15-second listing video, made from photos

playbook_section: Step 2: The 15-second listing video (No time to film?)

title: The photo dump is killing your listing
hook: STOP DUMPING 20 PHOTOS IN RANDOM ORDER
angle: Twenty photos with the gate or a blurry corridor first tells buyers nothing. Buyers decide in about a second, so the first photo must earn the next swipe.

five_elements.target: Agents who post every photo they took
five_elements.outcome: Buyers who keep swiping through the listing
five_elements.pain: A gate photo first and buyers scrolling past

playbook_section: Why most listings get no messages: 01 The photo dump

title: The order that sells: 8 photos in sequence
hook: POST YOUR PHOTOS IN THIS ORDER
angle: Order is a story: hero shot, living room, kitchen, master bedroom, master bathroom, other bedrooms, standout feature, neighbourhood. Same photos, clearer listing.

five_elements.target: Agents posting listing carousels on Instagram
five_elements.outcome: A carousel buyers swipe to the end
five_elements.benefit: Using the exact photos you already have
five_elements.pain: Buyers getting lost in random photos

playbook_section: Step 1: The order that sells

title: Hidden basics: why buyers don't bother asking
hook: IF THEY HAVE TO ASK, THEY LEAVE
angle: No location, no bedroom count, no price: people who have to ask for basics often don't bother. Showing the basics filters out time-wasters and brings serious buyers forward.

five_elements.target: Agents who keep details for the DMs
five_elements.outcome: Messages from serious buyers
five_elements.pain: Silence because buyers won't ask for basics

playbook_section: Why most listings get no messages: 03 Hidden basics

title: Myth: AI listing videos look fake
hook: "AI VIDEOS LOOK FAKE." NOT IF DONE RIGHT.
angle: AI only looks fake when it invents things. Done honestly, it moves through your real rooms, with no added furniture, rooms or views, so buyers see the home they will visit.

five_elements.target: Agency owners who doubt AI
five_elements.outcome: A premium video buyers trust
five_elements.pain: Worry that buyers will feel misled
five_elements.solution: Honest AI video from real photos (the 15-second listing video)

playbook_section: Step 2: The 15-second listing video (nothing fake)

title: The 5-line caption that gets messages
hook: THE CAPTION THAT GETS BUYERS TO MESSAGE
angle: Most captions say 'beautiful, spacious, DM for price'. I walk through the five lines (hook, basics, three highlights, price and location, one action) and why each one matters.

five_elements.target: Agents who write captions in a rush
five_elements.outcome: Captions that turn readers into enquiries
five_elements.benefit: Same five lines every time, no guesswork
five_elements.pain: 'DM for price' captions that get ignored

playbook_section: Step 3: The 5-line caption

title: 3 to 4 hours to reply is too slow
hook: YOUR REPLY CAME. THE BUYER HAD GONE.
angle: Busy agencies often take 3 to 4 hours to answer WhatsApp. By then a buyer has usually messaged three other agents. More enquiries only matter if someone answers fast.

five_elements.target: Busy agency owners handling WhatsApp themselves
five_elements.outcome: Turning enquiries into viewings
five_elements.benefit: No new tools needed to start
five_elements.pain: Buyers who go quiet after a few hours

playbook_section: Step 4: Reply fast, or lose them

title: Post layout: photo dump vs a post that sells
hook: SAME LISTING. TWO POSTS. SPOT THE DIFFERENCE.
angle: Before: a grid of random photos, gate first, no text. After: hero shot with a hook line, rooms in the order that sells, basics on a slide, one keyword at the end. Shown as a simple layout, no real photos.

five_elements.target: Agents who post listings as photo grids
five_elements.outcome: A post that gets noticed and understood
five_elements.pain: Posts that look like everyone else's
five_elements.solution: The order that sells + the 5-line caption

title: You don't need more listings

title: Your first WhatsApp reply: 4 things to send

title: Lead with your best shot, not the gate
hook: YOUR BEST SHOT GOES FIRST. ALWAYS.
angle: The first photo is your hook. Always lead with the single most impressive shot (pool, view, living room), even if it isn't the front of the house.

five_elements.outcome: Buyers who stop scrolling
five_elements.benefit: One small change, no new photos

title: All you do is send the photos

title: The 15-second listing video formula
hook: THE 15-SECOND VIDEO THAT GETS DMS
angle: Short videos reach far more people than photo posts. The formula: 0-3 seconds hook, 3-12 seconds tour of four or five spaces, 12-15 seconds the ask with one clear action.

five_elements.outcome: A video that turns views into messages
five_elements.pain: Long, slow videos nobody finishes

title: What AI should never do to your listing
hook: AI SHOULD NEVER ADD A FAKE ROOM
angle: Honest AI video moves through real rooms. It should never invent furniture, rooms or views. Buyers who feel misled at the viewing don't come back.

five_elements.target: Agents worried AI will mislead buyers
five_elements.outcome: Videos that build trust, not doubt
five_elements.pain: Viewings where buyers feel tricked
five_elements.solution: Honest AI video from real photos

title: Never edit the layout: honest beats perfect
hook: MAKE IT LOOK GOOD. KEEP IT HONEST.
angle: Stretching rooms, hiding cracks or adding views wins the click and loses the buyer at the viewing. Make it look good, keep it honest; misled buyers don't come back.

five_elements.target: Agents tempted to over-edit listing photos
five_elements.outcome: Viewings that turn into deals
five_elements.pain: Buyers who walk out feeling tricked
five_elements.solution: Step 1 photo rules (never edit the layout)

playbook_section: Step 1: Shoot photos that sell the home (Never edit the layout)

title: Turn one listing into a week of posts
hook: ONE LISTING. A WHOLE WEEK OF POSTS.
angle: One set of photos and one video can fill a week: Reel, carousel, TikTok, Facebook group post, Status, property site, then a repost. Planned once, posted steadily.

five_elements.target: Agents who run out of things to post
five_elements.outcome: A steady posting rhythm
five_elements.pain: Empty weeks with nothing to post

playbook_section: Step 4: One listing, five places

title: Real apartment listing: before vs after
hook: NOT JUST LUXURY HOMES. APARTMENTS TOO.
angle: Using one real apartment listing: the plain post, then the upgraded version with upbeat music, bright light and a clear ask. Premium packaging isn't only for villas.

five_elements.target: Agents renting apartments in Spintex or Kumasi
five_elements.outcome: Rentals that get enquiries quickly
five_elements.benefit: Uses the photos you already have
five_elements.pain: Thinking premium video is only for big houses

playbook_section: Step 2: The 15-second listing video (music: upbeat for apartments)

title: Follow up the buyer who went quiet
hook: THEY WENT QUIET. DON'T LET THEM GO.
angle: A buyer who stops replying isn't always lost; they got busy. One friendly follow-up with a new photo or a viewing time often restarts the chat.

five_elements.target: Agents with chats that stopped mid-way
five_elements.outcome: Reviving warm buyers
five_elements.pain: Buyers who go quiet after the first chat

playbook_section: Step 4: Reply fast, or lose them

title: Start January strong: free listing review
hook: START JANUARY WITH LISTINGS THAT GET NOTICED.
angle: Before the new year, send me photos of one current listing on WhatsApp. I'll show you how I'd turn it into a premium video and post you can use in January.

five_elements.target: Agency owners planning for January
five_elements.outcome: A listing ready to get noticed in the new year
five_elements.pain: Starting the year with the same ignored posts

playbook_section: Last page: Want this done for you? (free listing review)

title: The pre-posting checklist
hook: CHECK THESE 10 THINGS BEFORE YOU POST
angle: Hero shot first, daylight and no clutter, both shapes, 15-second video, captions readable with sound off, price and location, three highlights, one keyword, five places, someone ready to reply.

five_elements.target: Agents who want every listing done right
five_elements.outcome: Every listing packaged to get enquiries
five_elements.pain: Forgetting the step that would have brought buyers
